scope: Partial P02 correctness through frozen runs 14–15, with explicit overlay provenance, optional/physical-test exclusions, and bounded RAM/router, corpus, timer and diagnostic coverage. Real baseline-JIT probe 4 reaches later kernel initialization but times out before userspace.
limitations: P02 remains in progress. Bounded tests and source validation do not qualify full ISA, physical reference parity, userspace, glibc/systemd, stress, or release behavior.
Each run reports 11 XCTest cases with one optional PVH boot skip, plus one separately disabled physical-reference Swift test. These exclusions are not hidden in the successful Swift test counts.
Run 14 is not a clean committed-source gate: two interim PIT diagnostic files are retained exactly in its base-plus-overlay binding.
Run 15 is bound to f12f30d4f plus six separately hashed generated FFI inputs. Later live source changes, including PAE work, are excluded.
The arm64 macOS 27 beta / Xcode 26.6 / SDK 26.5 host tuple is experimental. Optimized executable construction and envelope schema validity do not imply release qualification.
HPET evidence covers selected routing and deadline behavior only; it does not qualify full comparator, periodic, wraparound, physical PIT/RTC suppression, ExtINT, or logical APIC semantics.
ByteArray is a bounded test/conformance fixture and Swift Array allocation failure is not made recoverable by the production mmap constructor fixes.
Generated FFI binaries and the optimized runner are identity-bound without vendoring their executable bytes.
Guest-handled exceptions are only visible when reported by the guest console; bounded runner diagnostics are not exhaustive fault history.

The newly retained baseline-JIT probe times out after 300 seconds without userspace or ACPI poweroff. Later kernel progress and timer diagnostics are observations, not successful boot, interpreter parity, or timer calibration qualification.
